Optional: put Epson's `epsonscan2-bundle-<version>.x86_64.deb.tar.gz` here before
`docker compose build` to use a specific (or newer) driver version, or if the
default download URL in the Dockerfile stops working.

Get it from https://support.epson.net/linux/en/epsonscan2.php
(deb, 64bit x86_64), or from Epson's download center for the FF-680W (Linux).
